cases.sentence: Я скажу тебе только, что дай эти же права, как наши ___, другому европейскому народу, – немцы и англичане выработали бы из них свободу, а мы вот только смеемся.
cases.explain: «земские учреждения» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “That’s how it always is!” Sergey Ivanovitch interrupted him. “We Russians are always like that. Perhaps it’s our strong point, really, the faculty of seeing our own shortcomings; but we overdo it, we comfort ourselves with irony which we always have on the tip of our tongues. All I say is, give such rights as our local self-government to any other European people—why, the Germans or the English would have worked their way to freedom from them, while we simply turn them into ridicule.”

cases.sentence: – Но что же делать? – виновато сказал Левин. – Это был мой ___.
cases.explain: «последний опыт» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “But how can it be helped?” said Levin penitently. “It was my last effort. And I did try with all my soul. I can’t. I’m no good at it.”

cases.sentence: – Я жалею, что сказал тебе это, – сказал Сергей Иваныч, покачивая головой на волнение ___. – Я посылал узнать, где он живет, и послал ему вексель его Трубину, по которому я заплатил.
cases.explain: «меньшого брата» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “I am sorry I told you,” said Sergey Ivanovitch, shaking his head at his younger brother’s excitement. “I sent to find out where he is living, and sent him his I.O.U. to Trubin, which I paid. This is the answer he sent me.”

cases.sentence: Это одно, чего я требую от своих ___.
cases.explain: «любезных братцев» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Levin read in the queer, familiar handwriting: “I humbly beg you to leave me in peace. That’s the only favor I ask of my gracious brothers.—Nikolay Levin.”

cases.sentence: В душе его боролись желание забыть теперь о ___ и сознание того, что это будет дурно.
cases.explain: «несчастном брате» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: There was a struggle in his heart between the desire to forget his unhappy brother for the time, and the consciousness that it would be base to do so.
